arts.ttl: Arteta hails ‘immense’ Arsenal after beating Bayern and keeping Kane quiet in Champions League
arts.sum: A 3-1 win over Bayern Munich on Wednesday left Arsenal as the only team with maximum points in the Champions League after five games, while also ending the German club’s unbeaten start to the season in all competitions. “They had an incredible match against, in my opinion, the best team in Europe,” Arteta said of his players.

arts.ttl: No way through: Kane experiences unwanted career first in Arsenal defeat
arts.sum: Bayern Munich star Harry Kane experienced an unwanted career first in Wednesday's Champions League defeat to Arsenal.

arts.ttl: Bayern's Neuer had a night to forget against Arsenal
arts.sum: Bayern Munich goalkeeper Manuel Neuer is the "star of the show" for the wrong reasons as Champions League analyst Thomas Hitzlsperger looks at his performance against Arsenal.

arts.ttl: Arsenal player who lost possession 17x vs Bayern Munich actually had his ‘most complete’ game ever

arts.ttl: Mikel Arteta warns his flying Gunners can get BETTER in ominous message to rivals after Arsenal shattered Bayern Munich's unbeaten record
arts.sum: IAN LADYMAN AT THE EMIRATES: Goals from Jurrien Timber, Noni Madueke and Garbriel Martinelli helped Arsenal sweep Bayern aside and end a run without defeat for the German side.

arts.ttl: Mikel Arteta insists Bayern Munich are ‘best team in Europe’ despite Arsenal masterclass
arts.sum: Arsenal demolished Bayern 3-1 in a statement victory to confirm themselves as Champions League favourites but Arteta insisted the German giants are still the team to beat

arts.ttl: Fans ridicule Manuel Neuer after Bayern Munich goalkeeper, 39, is embarrassed by Gabriel Martinelli in Arsenal's 3-1 win at the Emirates: 'Pack it up old man'
arts.sum: Fans have ruthlessly mocked Bayern Munich goalkeeper Manuel Neuer after the veteran was embarrassingly exposed by Gabriel Martinelli during Arsenal's 3-1 win over the German giants.

arts.ttl: Bayern defender Jonathan Tah praises Arsenal's attention to details
arts.sum: Facing the press after Bayern’s 1–3 defeat to Arsenal, Bayern's Jonathan Tah delivered composed but pointed remarks, outlining both the frustrations and the lessons from a difficult evening.

arts.ttl: Arsenal 3-1 Bayern Munich PLAYER RATINGS: Which Gunners star was a real attacking threat? Who controlled the game? And how did Harry Kane score?
arts.sum: ISAAN KHAN AT THE EMIRATES: Arsenal produced a superb performance as they comfortably beat Bayern Munich 3-1 on Wednesday.
